meta.title: Forward auction (tick 1): keep the same price

steps.note: Open the prepared live auction without recreating or searching for the event.
Move to the separate supplier session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live forward auction and its pricing bid sheet as the vendor.

args.because: difference must be at least one tick

steps.note: Submit the same price as the existing 100 bid and require Procol to refuse the zero-difference revision.
Return to the buyer session to verify that the rejected revision did not create another response or change the bid.
Confirm the buyer still sees exactly the original direct vendor response.
Open Master QCS for the final bid value check.
Confirm the comparison grid still contains the single real vendor column.
Verify the original 100 price remains after the refused same-price revision.
